title: 卡蜜尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 利落银色短发衬着淡蓝机械双眼，脸颊带有棱角分明的细节。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Camille is an elegant older woman with a sharp silver bob, pale blue mechanical eyes, angular cheek details, and a precise upright bearing. Preserve her long dark high-collared coat and fully covering mechanical leg structure. Her distinctive elongated blade legs remain attached, grounded, and clearly articulated from the hips, with no raised kicking pose, exposed body panels, or weapon-like swing.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: silver gray, midnight navy, ice blue, pale brass; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
